images.filename: Air Traffic Control, RAF Topcliffe - geograph.org.uk - 430545.jpg
images.caption: Air Traffic Control, RAF Topcliffe The RAF still has a presence at Topcliffe. The airfield acts as a Relief Landing Ground for RAF Linton-on-Ouse and sits in an enclave inside Alanbrooke Barracks. The 'Topcliffe Tower' sign on the grass in front of the tower, is from a now demolished tower block in Castle Vale, in the West Midlands.

images.filename: 102 Squadron Whitley at RAF Topcliffe WWII IWM CH 2052.jpg
images.caption: IWM caption : Whitley Mark V, T4162 'DY-S' "Ceylon", of No. 102 Squadron RAF, on the ground at Topcliffe, Yorkshire. It failed to return from a bombing raid on Cologne on the night of 1/2 March 1941.
